note: Duplicate-package gate added 2026-07-26 (Dependabot #376 forensics) — the budget number is UNCHANGED at 310 KB; what changed is that check-bundle-size now ALSO fails when any package is bundled from two install locations. Why: #376 measured 381.43 KB (123%) and the size gate could only report the symptom. Cause was TWO complete copies of zod v4 in the shipped bundle — 4.3.6 hoisted at the workspace root (what @ggui-ai/protocol declares) plus 4.4.3 nested under @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps AND @modelcontextprotocol/sdk, locale tables included: +334.6 KB raw attributed under ext-apps and +81.0 KB under sdk, which accounts for the entire +414 KB raw delta. Mechanism: both MCP packages take zod as a PEER ("^3.25.0 || ^4.0.0") and this workspace runs autoInstallPeers, so that peer resolves independently of whatever range the workspace already declares; a partially-regenerated lockfile — exactly what a Dependabot group bump produces — lets the frozen entry and the freshly-resolved peer land on different 4.x minors, and esbuild inlines both. Confirmed NONDETERMINISTIC: the same lockfile reproduced the duplicate on one install and not on a later one, because pnpm hoisted-linker placement depends on pre-existing node_modules state. That nondeterminism is precisely why the gate measures the BUNDLE rather than the lockfile. Remedy is "pnpm dedupe" — verified: it collapsed the tree to a single zod and brought #376 to 286.37 KB, 10 KB BELOW main. Note that a size budget can never substitute for this check: two zod copies sail through unnoticed on any day the budget happens to have 85 KB of headroom. Also settled by the same forensics: none of #376’s three majors were implicated — astro 5→7 alone measured 296.19 KB against main’s 296.48 KB, and vitest / @hono/node-server are not runtime deps of this bundle at all. Bumped 2026-05-28 from 300 KB → 310 KB to absorb @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps App-class adoption (Phase 1.19b.3) — bootSequence now drives the ui/initialize handshake via App.connect(transport), and outbound tools/call dispatch + post-mount tool-result re-listening + host-context-changed observation all flow through the spec-canonical App event surfaces. Net added ~10 KB gz: mostly zod-v4 schemas the App class registers for every notification it speaks (toolresult, hostcontextchanged, toolinput, toolinputpartial, toolcancelled) plus the JSON-RPC Protocol class from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk that App extends. Acceptable cost — retired four hand-rolled window.message listeners (makeJsonRpcCaller's closure listener, installPostMountListener, ensurePostRpcToParentListener for outbound tools/call responses, host-context-emitter.attachListener) AND the hand-rolled installResizeObserver in favor of App's autoResize. Reading-B (Tier 2: result.toolOutput._meta) is RETIRED structurally — App.connect doesn't expose result.toolOutput, so every slice-meta delivery now flows through inline __GGUI_META__ or the spec-canonical ui/notifications/tool-result notification observed via app.addEventListener('toolresult').
